name: Secret Fetch Test
shortDescription: Fetches a named secret via pipeline_sdk.env.get_secret() and reports whether it worked — proves the secret manager works inside a real running node
description: A minimal source node (no upstream input) that calls pipeline_sdk.env.get_secret(secretName) at run time and writes a small proof file: whether the fetch succeeded, the value's length, and a SHA-256 hash of the value. The real value is never printed to logs or written to any output.

name.label: Name
name.description: Unique identifier for this node in the pipeline

secretName.label: Secret Name
secretName.description: Name of the secret to fetch from the Secret Manager (must match a name you stored in your profile menu's Secrets panel)

outputDescription: A JSON proof file: whether the secret was fetched, its length, and a hash — never the raw value
